name: Board Risk Committee Charter Effective 2026-01-15
description: The Board Risk Committee Charter is the foundational governance document establishing the committee's mandate, authority, and operating procedures. Effective from 2026-01-15, it defines the committee's role in overseeing risk management across FirstUK Bank and sets the framework for risk governance at board level.
context: FirstUK Bank — Board Risk Committee Charter

name: Board Office
description: The Board Office is the department responsible for managing and maintaining the Board Risk Committee Charter and supporting board governance functions at FirstUK Bank.

name: Board of Directors
description: The Board of Directors is the governing body responsible for oversight of FirstUK Bank's risk management framework and is the owner of the Board Risk Committee Charter.

name: Board Risk Committee
description: A standing committee of the Board of Directors responsible for overseeing FirstUK Bank's enterprise risk management, capital adequacy, and internal controls. The BRC serves as the primary governance body for risk oversight and strategic risk decisions.
context: The Board Risk Committee (BRC) is a standing committee of the Board of Directors
responsible for overseeing FirstUK Bank's enterprise risk management, capital adequacy, and internal controls

name: FirstUK Bank
description: The banking institution whose enterprise risk management, capital adequacy, and internal controls are overseen by the Board Risk Committee.
context: FirstUK Bank's enterprise risk management, capital adequacy, and internal controls

name: Risk Committee Charter
description: Formal charter defining the composition, independence requirements, and governance structure of the Risk Committee. Establishes that the committee must be chaired by an independent non-executive director with a majority of independent members, and specifies the roles of the Chief Risk Officer and Chief Financial Officer as non-voting executives.
context: Majority of members must be independent (per FCA/PRA definition)
Chief Risk Officer (executive, non-voting in deliberations)
No executive directors as voting members (except as observers)

name: Independent Non-Executive Director
description: Board-level governance role responsible for chairing the Risk Committee and providing independent oversight. Must meet FCA/PRA independence criteria and constitute the majority of voting committee members.
context: Majority of members must be independent (per FCA/PRA definition)

name: Chief Risk Officer
description: Executive member of the Risk Committee with non-voting status in deliberations. Provides risk expertise and executive perspective to committee discussions.
context: Chief Risk Officer (executive, non-voting in deliberations)

name: Chief Financial Officer
description: Executive member of the Risk Committee with non-voting status in deliberations. Provides financial and capital perspective to risk committee oversight.
context: Chief Financial Officer (executive, non-voting in deliberations)

name: Committee Secretary
description: Administrative support role appointed by the Board to provide secretarial services to the Risk Committee. Responsible for maintaining records and meeting minutes.

name: Committee Independence
description: Governance risk related to maintaining appropriate independence standards on the Risk Committee as defined by FCA/PRA regulations. Requires majority independent membership and an independent chair to ensure objective risk oversight.
context: Majority of members must be independent (per FCA/PRA definition)
No executive directors as voting members (except as observers)

name: Capital Adequacy Risk
description: The risk that the bank's capital ratios fall below regulatory minimums or internal thresholds, impacting the bank's ability to absorb losses and meet regulatory requirements. Strategic oversight includes monitoring capital ratios against Pillar 1 minimum thresholds and assessing capital adequacy through stress testing.

name: Credit Risk
description: The risk of loss arising from borrower default or deterioration in loan portfolio quality. Strategic oversight includes review of credit strategy, monitoring loan portfolio quality, assessment of borrower concentration risk, and review of major lending decisions.
context: Review credit strategy and risk limits

name: Operational Risk
description: The risk of loss resulting from inadequate or failed internal processes, people, systems, or external events. Oversight includes review of operational risk incidents, assessment of the control environment, and monitoring of operational risk KRIs.

name: Compliance Risk
description: The risk of regulatory sanctions, financial loss, or reputational damage arising from failure to comply with applicable laws, regulations, and supervisory requirements. Oversight includes monitoring regulatory compliance, reviewing audit findings, and assessing regulatory relationships.

name: Fraud and Financial Crime Risk
description: The risk of loss or reputational damage from fraudulent activity, money laundering, or other financial crime. Oversight includes review of fraud incidents and investigations, monitoring of AML/KYC effectiveness, review of SAR filings, and assessment of anti-fraud controls.

name: Cybersecurity and Technology Risk
description: The risk of loss or operational disruption arising from cybersecurity threats, system failures, or inadequate technology infrastructure. Oversight includes review of cybersecurity risks, monitoring of system availability, assessment of major technology investments, and review of incident response procedures.

name: Emerging Strategic Risk
description: The risk of loss or strategic impact arising from emerging threats to the bank's business model, market position, or strategic objectives. Oversight includes assessment of emerging risks to the bank's strategy.
context: Assess emerging risks to the bank's strategy

name: Borrower Concentration Risk
description: The risk of excessive exposure to a single borrower or group of related borrowers, potentially amplifying credit losses. Oversight includes assessment of borrower concentration risk as part of credit risk management.

name: Capital Ratio
description: The regulatory capital ratio measured under Pillar 1 framework, with a minimum threshold of greater than 15%. This metric is monitored to ensure the bank maintains adequate capital buffers above regulatory minimums.

name: Operational Risk Key Risk Indicator
description: A quantitative indicator used to monitor operational risk exposure and control effectiveness. Monitoring of operational risk KRIs is part of the board's oversight of the operational risk control environment.

name: Risk Management
description: The department responsible for developing and maintaining the enterprise risk management framework, which is subject to board approval and oversight.

name: Compliance
description: The department responsible for monitoring regulatory compliance, managing audit findings and remediation, and assessing regulatory relationships.

name: Financial Crime
description: The department responsible for managing fraud incidents, AML/KYC controls, SAR filings, and anti-fraud measures.

name: Technology
description: The department responsible for cybersecurity, system availability, technology investments, and incident response procedures.

name: Credit
description: The department responsible for credit strategy, loan portfolio management, and major lending decisions.
context: Review credit strategy and risk limits

name: Capital Management
description: The department responsible for monitoring capital ratios, approving capital raising and deployment decisions, and managing capital distribution.

name: Mortgage
description: A mortgage lending product subject to major lending decision review by the board, with specific oversight for mortgages exceeding £500,000.

name: Board of Directors
description: The Full Board of Directors receives key decisions and issues reported by the Chair. The Board is accountable to regulators (FCA, PRA) and may be met with directly by regulators.
context: Reports to: Full Board of Directors (Chair reports key decisions/issues)
Regulators may meet with committee directly

name: Risk Management
description: The Chief Risk Officer provides risk management updates to the reporting structure, contributing to the organization's risk oversight and governance.
context: Receives from: Chief Risk Officer (risk management updates)

name: Finance
description: The Chief Financial Officer provides capital and financial risk updates to the governance reporting structure.

name: Compliance
description: The Compliance Head reports on regulatory and AML/KYC matters to the governance structure, ensuring adherence to regulatory requirements.

name: Internal Audit
description: Internal Audit reports audit findings to the governance structure as part of the organization's control and oversight framework.

name: Technology
description: The Chief Technology Officer provides technology risk updates to the governance reporting structure.

name: Committee Chair Accountability to Board
description: The Committee Chair is accountable to the Board for governance decisions and oversight. This establishes the formal accountability line within the governance structure.

name: Board Regulatory Accountability Framework
description: The Board is accountable to regulators (FCA, PRA), with regulators having the right to meet with the committee directly. This establishes the regulatory oversight relationship.
context: Regulators may meet with committee directly

name: Quarterly Committee Meeting Schedule
description: Formal governance procedure establishing minimum quarterly meeting frequency for the committee, with provision for emergency meetings within 24 hours if critical risk is identified. Meetings require minimum attendance of 3 voting members with executive, legal, and audit participation as needed.
context: Emergency meetings as needed (within 24 hours if critical risk)
All voting members expected to attend (min. 3 per meeting)

name: Committee Meeting Agenda Setting and Notice Procedure
description: Governance procedure defining the Chair's responsibility to set meeting agendas with input from CRO, CFO, and Compliance. Standing agenda items include risk appetite, capital ratios, incidents, and KRIs. Agenda and papers must be provided 5 days in advance of meetings.
context: Chair sets agenda (input from CRO, CFO, Compliance)
Standing items: Risk appetite, capital ratios, incidents, KRIs
Advance notice: Agenda and papers provided 5 days before meeting

name: Committee Meeting Minutes Recording and Retention
description: Governance procedure establishing that the Committee Secretary records meeting minutes, which are approved by the Chair within 5 days and distributed to all Board members. Minutes are retained for 7 years and protected as Board materials under legal privilege.
context: Minutes approved by Chair within 5 days

name: Committee Executive Session Confidentiality Protocol
description: Governance procedure establishing confidentiality of committee discussions unless public disclosure is required, with quarterly executive sessions held without management present. Committee minutes are protected as Board materials under legal privilege.
context: Committee discussions confidential (unless public disclosure required)
Minutes protected as Board materials (legal privilege)

name: Committee Agenda Input from CRO, CFO, and Compliance
description: Standing action requiring the Chief Risk Officer, Chief Financial Officer, and Compliance function to provide input to the Committee Chair for agenda setting prior to each meeting.
context: Chair sets agenda (input from CRO, CFO, Compliance)

name: Committee Secretary Meeting Minutes Recording and Approval
description: Standing action requiring the Committee Secretary to record meeting minutes and submit them to the Chair for approval within 5 days, followed by distribution to all Board members.
context: Minutes approved by Chair within 5 days

name: Risk Appetite
description: Standing agenda item for committee meetings, indicating that risk appetite is a formal governance topic reviewed at minimum quarterly by the committee.
context: Standing items: Risk appetite, capital ratios, incidents, KRIs

name: Capital Ratios
description: Standing agenda item for committee meetings, indicating that capital ratio monitoring is a formal governance topic reviewed at minimum quarterly.
context: Standing items: Risk appetite, capital ratios, incidents, KRIs

name: Key Risk Indicators
description: Standing agenda item for committee meetings, indicating that Key Risk Indicators are formally monitored and reviewed at minimum quarterly by the committee.
context: Standing items: Risk appetite, capital ratios, incidents, KRIs

name: Chief Risk Officer
description: Executive function responsible for providing input to the Committee Chair on meeting agendas and participating in committee governance procedures.
context: Chair sets agenda (input from CRO, CFO, Compliance)

name: Chief Financial Officer
description: Executive function responsible for providing input to the Committee Chair on meeting agendas and participating in committee governance procedures.
context: Chair sets agenda (input from CRO, CFO, Compliance)

name: Compliance Function
description: Executive function responsible for providing input to the Committee Chair on meeting agendas and participating in committee governance procedures.
context: Chair sets agenda (input from CRO, CFO, Compliance)

name: Internal Audit
description: Function invited to attend committee meetings at least quarterly to provide audit oversight and assurance.

name: External Audit
description: External audit function invited to attend committee meetings at least annually to provide independent audit assurance.

name: Risk Appetite Statement
description: A formal statement defining the bank's tolerance for capital, losses, and regulatory risk exposure. The statement is reviewed annually and aligned with strategic objectives, then communicated to all business units to ensure consistent risk management across the organisation.

name: Capital Risk
description: Capital adequacy and distribution risk managed through annual capital planning, stress testing, and quarterly capital ratio monitoring. The bank assesses capital resilience under recession and market shock scenarios.
context: Stress testing scenarios (recession, market shock, fraud)

name: Fraud Risk
description: Fraud risk is incorporated into the bank's stress testing scenarios as part of capital planning and resilience assessment.
context: Stress testing scenarios (recession, market shock, fraud)

name: Market Risk
description: Market risk is subject to quarterly board oversight through market risk overview briefings to ensure awareness of market conditions and exposures.

name: Regulatory Risk
description: Regulatory risk encompasses FCA/PRA feedback, regulatory orders, and compliance concerns. The board approves regulatory responses and plans remediation for regulatory findings.

name: Emerging Risk
description: Emerging risks are monitored and communicated to the board through periodic briefings to ensure awareness of new and evolving risk exposures.

name: Annual Risk Appetite Statement Review
description: The board is responsible for reviewing the Risk Appetite Statement annually to ensure it remains aligned with strategic objectives and reflects current risk tolerances.

name: Annual Capital Plan Review
description: The board conducts an annual review of the capital plan, including stress testing under recession, market shock, and fraud scenarios.
context: Stress testing scenarios (recession, market shock, fraud)

name: Quarterly Capital Ratio Monitoring
description: The board monitors capital ratios on a quarterly basis to ensure the bank maintains adequate capital levels.

name: Annual Internal Audit Plan Review
description: The board reviews the Internal Audit plan annually and approves the Internal Audit budget as part of audit oversight responsibilities.

name: Internal Audit Findings and Remediation Monitoring
description: The board monitors audit findings and tracks remediation progress to ensure timely resolution of identified control weaknesses.

name: Internal Audit Independence Assessment
description: The board assesses the independence of the Internal Audit function to ensure it can operate without undue influence or constraint.

name: Regulatory Response Approval
description: The board approves the bank's responses to FCA/PRA feedback and regulatory orders.

name: Regulatory Remediation Planning
description: The board plans and oversees remediation activities for regulatory findings and concerns.

name: Annual Risk Management Training
description: The board receives annual risk management training to maintain competency in risk governance and oversight.

name: Quarterly Market Risk Overview
description: The board receives quarterly briefings on market risk conditions and exposures.

name: Emerging Risk Briefings
description: The board receives periodic briefings on emerging risks to maintain awareness of new and evolving risk exposures.

name: Regulatory Change Updates
description: The board receives updates on regulatory changes to ensure awareness of new compliance obligations and requirements.

name: Risk Appetite Communication to Business Units
description: The board ensures the Risk Appetite Statement is communicated to all business units to align risk management practices across the organisation.

name: Dividend and Distribution Approval
description: The board approves dividend and distribution decisions as part of capital planning oversight.

name: Risk Appetite Statement Approval
description: Committee-level decision authority for approval of the Risk Appetite Statement, establishing the organization's risk tolerance and strategic risk parameters.

name: Major Risk Policy Changes Approval
description: Committee-level decision authority for approval of major risk policy changes, including credit policy modifications and other significant risk governance updates.
context: Major risk policy changes (e.g., credit policy)

name: Risk Limits and KRIs Approval
description: Committee-level decision authority for approval of risk limits and Key Risk Indicators, establishing quantitative thresholds for risk monitoring and control.

name: Risk Remediation Strategies Approval
description: Committee-level decision authority for approval of risk remediation strategies when spend exceeds £500,000, requiring escalation beyond executive authority.

name: Large Lending Decisions Approval
description: Committee-level decision authority for approval of large lending decisions, specifically mortgages exceeding £500,000, requiring committee oversight.

name: Stress Testing Scenarios Approval
description: Committee-level decision authority for approval of stress testing scenarios used in risk assessment and capital adequacy planning.

name: Capital Raising and Deployment Approval
description: Board-level decision authority for approval of capital raising and deployment activities, reflecting strategic financial decisions.

name: Regulatory Capital Requirements Compliance Approval
description: Board-level decision authority for approval of regulatory capital requirements compliance, ensuring adherence to PRA/FCA capital standards.

name: Significant Strategic Risk Changes Approval
description: Board-level decision authority for approval of significant strategic risk changes that materially alter the organization's risk profile.

name: Major Acquisitions Approval
description: Board-level decision authority for approval of major acquisitions, where applicable, requiring strategic and risk oversight.

name: Large Financial Provisions and Write-offs Approval
description: Board-level decision authority for approval of large financial provisions and write-offs, reflecting material accounting and financial decisions.

name: Operational Risk Incident Management
description: Executive authority to manage operational risk incidents with losses below £10,000 without committee escalation, enabling rapid response to minor operational issues.

name: Credit Decisions Within Approved Limits
description: Executive authority to approve credit decisions that remain within pre-established risk appetite and lending limits, delegating routine credit approvals.

name: Fraud Reimbursement Processing
description: Executive authority to approve fraud reimbursements to customers below £5,000 without committee escalation, enabling timely customer remediation.

name: AML/KYC Standard Approvals
description: Executive authority to approve standard Anti-Money Laundering and Know Your Customer compliance activities within established procedures.

name: Technology Investments Below £100k
description: Executive authority to approve technology investments below £100,000 without committee escalation, enabling agile technology deployment.

name: Committee Self-Assessment Annual Review
description: Annual formal assessment of committee effectiveness, member skills and experience, and meeting processes. Results are reported to the Board with recommendations for improvements, training needs, and process enhancements.

name: Committee Composition Assessment
description: Evaluation of committee composition including assessment of member skills, independence, and diversity as part of the annual self-assessment process.

name: Meeting Effectiveness Evaluation
description: Assessment of meeting effectiveness including time use, agenda relevance, quality of information and papers provided, and engagement with management.

name: Stakeholder Communication Review
description: Assessment of stakeholder communication effectiveness as part of the committee self-assessment areas evaluated.

name: Board Reporting of Assessment Results
description: Formal reporting of committee self-assessment results to the Board following the annual effectiveness review.

name: Committee Training Identification and Delivery
description: Identification of training needs through the self-assessment process and provision of training to committee members.

name: Committee Process Improvements Implementation
description: Implementation of process improvements identified through the annual committee self-assessment and effectiveness review.

name: Risk Committee Chair Meeting with Regulators
description: Authority granted to the Risk Committee Chair to meet directly with FCA/PRA regulators. This represents a formal governance arrangement for direct regulatory engagement and communication.
context: Risk Committee Chair may meet with regulators directly
Committee updates sent to regulators (annually or as requested)

name: Regulatory Concerns Escalation Protocol
description: Formal governance protocol requiring immediate escalation of regulatory concerns and orders to the Risk Committee. Regulatory feedback is subsequently discussed in committee meetings.

name: Annual Regulatory Committee Updates
description: Standing action item to send Risk Committee updates to FCA/PRA regulators on an annual basis or as specifically requested by regulators.
context: Committee updates sent to regulators (annually or as requested)

name: Regulatory Compliance Risk
description: Risk that the Risk Committee fails to meet regulatory standards for composition, meeting frequency, risk oversight detail, or documentation retention as required by FCA/PRA regulations.
context: Risk oversight sufficiently detailed per regulations

name: Risk Committee
description: Governance body responsible for risk oversight, regulatory correspondence, and escalation of regulatory concerns. The committee maintains direct engagement with FCA/PRA and ensures compliance with regulatory standards.
context: Risk Committee Chair may meet with regulators directly
Committee updates sent to regulators (annually or as requested)

name: Board Governance Structure
description: The formal board governance structure that defines decision-making authority and committee responsibilities within the organisation. Referenced as a foundational policy document governing organisational hierarchy and governance processes.

name: Operational Risk
description: Operational risk management framework and policy governing the identification, assessment, and mitigation of operational losses and failures. Establishes the bank's approach to managing operational risk across all business functions.

name: Know Your Customer Verification
description: The customer identification and verification policy establishing KYC requirements and procedures for identity and address verification. Forms part of the bank's compliance framework for customer due diligence obligations.

name: Anti-Money Laundering Screening
description: The Anti-Money Laundering policy establishing screening, monitoring, and reporting obligations for financial crime compliance. Governs sanctions list checks, PEP screening, and transaction monitoring procedures.

name: Risk Department
description: The organisational department responsible for risk management, policy development, and oversight of risk-related governance and compliance functions across the bank.

name: Committee Charter Review Approval 2026-01-15
description: Full Board of Directors approval of the Committee Charter Review conducted on 2026-01-15. The charter review is conducted annually or upon Board/regulatory change, with the next review scheduled for 2027-01-15.
context: Review Frequency: Annual (or upon Board/regulatory change)
Changes Approved By: Full Board of Directors

name: Committee Charter Implementation
description: Implementation of approved Committee Charter changes following Full Board approval. The effective implementation date is upon Board approval, with the charter subject to annual review or upon any Board or regulatory change.
context: Changes Approved By: Full Board of Directors
Review Frequency: Annual (or upon Board/regulatory change)

name: Committee Charter Next Review Scheduled 2027-01-15
description: Scheduled governance review of the Committee Charter for 2027-01-15, establishing the annual review cycle. This represents the Board's commitment to periodic charter governance oversight.
context: Review Frequency: Annual (or upon Board/regulatory change)

name: Board Approval of Initial Charter
description: Formal board approval of the initial charter document, version 1.0, establishing the foundational governance framework. This represents the first formal governance decision documented in the charter history.

name: Board Adoption of Risk Governance Framework
description: Formal adoption and approval of the risk governance framework by the Board of Directors on 15 January 2026. This represents the board's official endorsement of the governance structure and risk management policies outlined in the document.
context: Adopted by: Board of Directors — Date: 2026-01-15

name: Risk Committee Chair Approval of Risk Governance Framework
description: Formal approval of the risk governance framework by the Risk Committee Chair on 15 January 2026. This represents the Risk Committee's official endorsement and oversight confirmation of the governance structure.
context: Adopted by: Board of Directors — Date: 2026-01-15 Risk Committee Chair — Date: 2026-01-15
